apotheosis: Apo + theos: becoming god. The apotheosis of the empire.
benighted: Be + night: in darkness. Benighted peasants.
blinkered: Blinkers on a horse. A blinkered view.
curmudgeon: Curmudgeon: crusty old person. A curmudgeon complains.
disabuse: Dis + abuse: free from error. Disabuse him of that idea.
excoriate: Ex + corium: skin off. Excoriate the critics.
execrate: Ex + sacrare: curse. Execrate the tyrant.
expurgate: Ex + purgare: clean out. Expurgate the novel.
impecunious: In + pecunia: no money. An impecunious student.
invective: Invehi: attack. A stream of invective.
juggernaut: Jagannath cart. A juggernaut of change.
malapropism: Mrs Malaprop in a play: wrong words. “Illiterate” for “alliterate”.
martinet: General Martinet. A martinet for rules.
mellifluous: Mel + fluere: honey flowing. A mellifluous voice.
palimpsest: Palin + psao: scraped again. A palimpsest manuscript.
parvenu: Parvenir: arrive. A parvenu flaunting wealth.
peremptory: Per + emere: cut off. A peremptory order.
pyrrhic: Pyrrhus: costly win. A pyrrhic victory.
quisling: Quisling: Norwegian traitor. A quisling collaborator.
quixotic: Don Quixote: windmills. A quixotic plan.
remonstrate: Re + monstrare: show again. Remonstrate with the manager.
sangfroid: Sang + froid: cold blood. Keep sangfroid.
schadenfreude: Schaden + Freude: harm-joy. Schadenfreude at a rival’s failure.
sybarite: Sybaris: luxury city. A sybarite loves silk.
